commit.message:
core: make comparable_path_key existence-independent (fix flaky Build Desktop)

prune_unused_files records each round file's "active" key BEFORE the file is
synced, then recomputes the key while walking the cache AFTER it exists. The
key used path.canonicalize(), which only resolves once the file is on disk —
and on Windows also expands 8.3 short names and junctions. So the before/after
keys diverged, the active file matched nothing in active_paths, and prune
deleted the file it had just synced. On the GitHub Windows runner the temp dir
carries an 8.3 short name, so runner::tests::prune_keeps_file_marked_active_
before_it_exists failed there (but not on Linux), which is why Build Desktop
has been red on every commit while Test stayed green.

Fix: canonicalize only the longest EXISTING ancestor and re-append the
remaining components lexically, so the key is identical whether or not the leaf
exists yet. Add a deterministic, cross-platform regression test asserting the
key is stable across file creation (it fails on the old code on any OS).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
